ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var path = vars.sisextPromotionsPath default "" var isMobile = (path contains "mobile") var emptyResponse = (p('sisext-sapi.promotions.mock.emptyResponse') default "false") as Boolean --- if (emptyResponse) readUrl("classpath://mocks/promotions-empty.json", "application/json") else if (isMobile) readUrl("classpath://mocks/promotions-mobile.json", "application/json") else readUrl("classpath://mocks/promotions-fixed.json", "application/json")

http:request.doc:name: Call sisext promotions
http:request.http:headers: #[output application/java --- { "client_secret" : p('sisext-sapi.client_secret'), "client_id" : p('sisext-sapi.client_id'), "Content-Type" : "application/json", "X-CORRELATION-ID" : (attributes.headers.'x-correlation-id' default attributes.headers.'X-CORRELATION-ID') default correlationId, "systemId" : (attributes.headers.systemId default vars.systemId) default "MIGRACION", ("name" : attributes.headers.name) if (attributes.headers.name != null), ("source" : attributes.headers.source) if (attributes.headers.source != null) }]
